sources.note: Socrata dataset id psx4-wq38. Published by CDC's National Center for Injury Prevention and Control (NCIPC), based on NCHS/NVSS mortality data. Crude death rate per 100,000 residents (not age-adjusted). For counties with 1-9 deaths, CDC applies a Bayesian spatial model (flagged rate_m=1 in source) to stabilize small-area rates and protect privacy; all other rates are direct/observed calculations from vital records. Data marked 'as of' 05/14/2026 (still labeled provisional per CDC NVSS conventions for the most recent year). CSV export: https://data.cdc.gov/api/views/psx4-wq38/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD
